new_sources.title: Franca Iacovetta, “Writing Women’s Community-based Pluralism into the History of Canadian Multiculturalism”, Zeitschrift für Kanada-Studien 39 (2019), 28–45

verification.note: Own article read in scoped passages: pp. 29–32 on double-edged pluralism and women’s activism; pp. 35–42 on ethnic cultural assertion, mediated case files, parental negotiation and contradictory marital/gender ideals. These passages independently support the two Iacovetta contribution edges. Case files are mediated, outcomes often unknown, and the Institute primarily served European newcomers; no universal account of all immigrants or complete monograph reading is asserted.
